title: eol payload
description: endoflife.date-shaped feed: component -> eol date plus the base unpatched-CVE rate at end of support. Derived from the shape platform/feeds/eol/v1,v2/eol-feed.json already published (ticket 21, ADR-0019). The entry map is `components`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the loss magnitudes in this feed are stated in (the `_gbp` suffix on the magnitude key named it already; this makes the declaration explicit, ticket 84). REQUIRED from this version on: a subscriber reading a magnitude with no declared currency would have to assume its own, which mints a currency instead of converting one (ADR-0020). Composition reads this field first and the key's own suffix where an older checkout carries none.
